findings.desc: CHK-003:adversarial coverage promises the smoke fails when representative help output loses dry-run/owner lease guidance, but packages/main/src/tasks/command-catalog-smoke.ts:96-113 only asserts story_advance help contains Lattice CLI/lattice story_advance/--phase/INIT_CHECK and does not assert --dryRun or Owner lease meta options. I verified node bin/lattice.js story_advance --help currently contains both, so deleting those help markers would not fail the smoke. Add explicit includes/assertions for --dryRun and owner lease guidance.
findings.resolvedReason: Updated packages/main/src/tasks/command-catalog-smoke.ts so the existing story_advance --help representative smoke asserts --dryRun, the rendered dry-run guidance line, Owner lease meta options, --takeover, and --forceTakeover. Verified with npm --prefix packages/main run test:command-catalog-smoke, npm --prefix packages/main run build, node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs, and node bin/lattice.js validate --story=B-74a0 --json.
